title: Modular Car & Couch Organizer – “ARENA MAS”
author: rafaloukas
description:
This is a multi-purpose 3D-printed organizer designed for car dashboards, couches, desks, or anywhere you need extra organization.

It features:

• 3 circular compartments for drinks, cables, keys, or other gear

• Central flat area for phones, wallets, or tools

• Custom front branding – this one says “ARENA MAS” (editable in the design)

• Great for airsoft arenas, drivers, and home use

• Sturdy design, prints without supports Perfect for anyone who needs a bit more order in their vehicle or chill zone.
